**Beta.** HACS only offers it if you enable beta versions for Awtrix Studio (⋮ → Redownload → Show beta versions).

### New
- **A label in its own color.** In simple mode, the label of an entity can have a color of its own, different from the value's: a white `Pool` before a blue `27.5°C`, for example. It works for one entity, for several on a line, and in the layouts of the TC002.
- **A default icon for template apps.** Template apps get the icon picker too. The icon you choose goes to every page that names none, so you no longer type it in each page of your template.
- **A "Value and time" layout on the TC002.** It shows the current time above the value, without a time sensor.
- **More ways to scroll and to color on AWTRIX NG.** A text too long for the screen can loop or bounce, and a rainbow or gradient text can move, at the speed and width you choose.
- **Text on the left in a layout.** Unticking **Center** now starts the text of a layout at the left of its box.
- **Reconfigure a clock.** Change its MQTT prefix or its firmware without removing it, and give the user name and password of its web page if you protected it.
- **AWTRIX NG clocks are found by themselves.** Home Assistant offers to add them as soon as they show up on your MQTT broker.
- **Diagnostics.** A clock's diagnostics can be downloaded from Home Assistant to join to a bug report. They hold no password, address or template.

### Fixed
- **The colors of the entities on one line, on AWTRIX NG.** As on AWTRIX 3, each entity now keeps its own color.
- **Apps too large for an AWTRIX NG clock.** The clock drops them without a word. Awtrix Studio no longer sends them and says why in the panel, exactly at the size where the clock gives up. What the clock refuses for another reason is shown in the panel as well.
- **Layouts refused by the clock.** A layout with an effect whose colors were set not to blend, but without a palette, was refused by the clock and never showed.
- **A preview closer to the clock on AWTRIX NG.** Text sits in its box where the clock puts it, progress bars have the clock's length, a rainbow or gradient paints the whole text of a layout, and on a TC002 that does not enlarge apps, a one-line app is drawn in the middle of the screen.

Existing apps keep working as they are. There is nothing to change after updating.

### Thanks
Thank you to [u/dyabolikarl](https://www.reddit.com/user/dyabolikarl) for the idea of a label in its own color, and to werner2000x for asking for the time next to a value.
